overfanout_roles: ISCO 5329 (Healthcare Support Workers not elsewhere classified) — massive fan-out: 8 of 17 rows attached via 5329, most being unrelated SOC group-labels (massage therapists, endoscopy techs, medical transcriptionists, SLP assistants, equipment preparers) or other-domain support roles.
reviews.notes: Severe contamination. Domain should center on community/primary-health cadres: community health worker, CHEW, JCHEW, nurse assistant, healthcare assistant, first aid instructor are the legitimate core (home care aide borderline-keep as community/social care). 6 aka=NaN SOC group-label junk rows + optics/lab/hospital support cross-domain rows removed. Root cause is an ISCO-5329 subject/commodity fan-out.
